serviceTypes.title: Cost Plus
serviceTypes.description: Use this service to request brush/bulky pickup or for building materials that EXCEED the normal collection size. Items must be placed at front curb or parkway to get an estimate.
serviceTypes.details:
Use Annual 20 Cubic Yard Exemption to request exemption for oversize collection of brush/bulk debris. SLA: 1 business day

Use Sanitation Commercial Services to request new roll cart services and/or dumpster service, make changes to existing commercial service, or cancel service. ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 10 business days
 
Use Cost Plus to request on-demand collection of various brush and/or bulk solid waste materials.  ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Use Helping Hands to initiate/cancel/renew garbage and recycle collection assistance. ERT: 5 business days   SLA: 20 business days

Use Litter Cans  issues concerning the service of litter cans. ERT: 1 business days   SLA: 5 business days
 
Use Missed collections requests to report a missed collection.

Recycle & Garbage ERT: 2 business days    SLA: 3 business days
Brush/Bulk ERT: 2 business days   SLA: 7 business days

Use Pack Out to request pack out service. ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Use Property Damage to report damage to property caused by Sanitation trucks. ERT: 3 business days  SLA: 10 business days

Use Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery to request repair, replacement, or delivery of roll carts. ERT: 2 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Annual 20 Cubic Yard Exemption notes:
The service request must be submitted the week prior to the scheduled brush/bulk collection week. An excessive fee of $60 per five cubic yards may apply if applicable limits are exceeded. A resident may also be subject to a citation by Code Compliance for violating the limit.

Sanitation Commercial Services notes: 
An active Dallas Water Utilities account is required to proceed with this request. Businesses, City facilities, and multi-family properties can request commercial roll cart services. Only City facilities can request dumpster service. Residents in a multi-family property will be approved on a case-by-case basis. A signed CSA (commercial service agreement) must be obtained to provide/continue commercial service. 
 
Cost Plus notes:
Estimates are no longer provided by the Sanitation Districts. A minimum fee of $60 plus tax will be directly billed to the associated Dallas Water Utilities for services rendered but is subject to increase based upon the cubic yard load size. Items must be placed at the front curb or parkway (no alley or back pickup) within 24 hours of submitting.

Citizens needing to dispose of cost plus items can also take them to the landfill or one of the three transfer stations.

Helping Hands notes: 
A Helping Hands Program application and Declaration of Special Need form must be completed, signed, and returned to Sanitation headquarters for review and approval. Customers who do not have an able bodied person living in the residence that can relocate their roll cart(s) to the point of collection may be eligible for the Helping Hands Program at no additional cost. 
 
All customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related Sanitation fees being billed. 

Litter Cans notes: 
Litter cans are the metal containers found on the median at a stop light or on the sidewalk in front of a business.
 
If the litter can is at a DART Station or DART bus stop, contact DART. 
 
Missed Recycle & Missed Garbage notes:
Sanitation has until 8pm to pick up items.

Missed Bulk/Brush notes:
Sanitation has until 6pm on the Friday of the scheduled collection week to pick up items. Commercial accounts are not currently serviced for brush/bulky collections.

Missed collections notes (all collections):
An orange tag at the collection location indicates that a collection violation was identified and needs to be corrected in order to receive service.

Pack Out notes:
For an additional fee, customers can add Pack-Out service which enables sanitation crews to go onto private property (at an approved location) to provide collection service for City issued garbage/recycle roll cart(s). An application is required for this service.

All customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related Sanitation fees. 

Property Damage notes: 
Enter a Compliment/Complaint service request if also filing a complaint against the driver.

For damaged roll carts, enter a Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery service request.

Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery notes:
Only residential customers can request a new roll cart or addition/removal of a roll cart. All customers can request maintenance of an existing roll cart. See the Sanitation website for the latest fees for additional roll carts. The owner or occupant of a dwelling unit with one roll cart for recyclable materials may request one additional roll cart for recyclable materials with no additional fee applied. Dwelling units with two or more roll carts for recyclable materials may request additional roll carts for recyclable materials for a one-time processing and handling fee of $50.00 per roll cart, which will be applied to the dwelling unit’s water account.

serviceTypes.details:
Use Annual 20 Cubic Yard Exemption to request exemption for oversize collection of brush/bulk debris. SLA: 1 business day

Use Sanitation Commercial Services to request new roll cart services and/or dumpster service, make changes to existing commercial service, or cancel service. ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 10 business days
 
Use Cost Plus to request on-demand collection of various brush and/or bulk solid waste materials.  ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Use Helping Hands to initiate/cancel/renew garbage and recycle collection assistance. ERT: 5 business days   SLA: 20 business days

Use Litter Cans  issues concerning the service of litter cans. ERT: 1 business days   SLA: 5 business days
 
Use Missed collections requests to report a missed collection.

Recycle & Garbage ERT: 2 business days    SLA: 3 business days
Brush/Bulk ERT: 2 business days   SLA: 7 business days

Use Pack Out to request pack out service. ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Use Property Damage to report damage to property caused by Sanitation trucks. ERT: 3 business days  SLA: 10 business days

Use Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery to request repair, replacement, or delivery of roll carts. ERT: 2 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Annual 20 Cubic Yard Exemption notes:
The service request must be submitted the week prior to the scheduled brush/bulk collection week. An excessive fee of $60 per five cubic yards may apply if applicable limits are exceeded. A resident may also be subject to a citation by Code Compliance for violating the limit.

Sanitation Commercial Services notes: 
An active Dallas Water Utilities account is required to proceed with this request. Businesses, City facilities, and multi-family properties can request commercial roll cart services. Only City facilities can request dumpster service. Residents in a multi-family property will be approved on a case-by-case basis. A signed CSA (commercial service agreement) must be obtained to provide/continue commercial service. 
 
Cost Plus notes:
Estimates are no longer provided by the Sanitation Districts. A minimum fee of $60 plus tax will be directly billed to the associated Dallas Water Utilities for services rendered but is subject to increase based upon the cubic yard load size. Items must be placed at the front curb or parkway (no alley or back pickup) within 24 hours of submitting.

Citizens needing to dispose of cost plus items can also take them to the landfill or one of the three transfer stations.

Helping Hands notes: 
A Helping Hands Program application and Declaration of Special Need form must be completed, signed, and returned to Sanitation headquarters for review and approval. Customers who do not have an able bodied person living in the residence that can relocate their roll cart(s) to the point of collection may be eligible for the Helping Hands Program at no additional cost. 
 
All customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related Sanitation fees being billed. 

Litter Cans notes: 
Litter cans are the metal containers found on the median at a stop light or on the sidewalk in front of a business.
 
If the litter can is at a DART Station or DART bus stop, contact DART. 
 
Missed Recycle & Missed Garbage notes:
Sanitation has until 8pm to pick up items.

Missed Bulk/Brush notes:
Sanitation has until 6pm on the Friday of the scheduled collection week to pick up items. Commercial accounts are not currently serviced for brush/bulky collections.

Missed collections notes (all collections):
An orange tag at the collection location indicates that a collection violation was identified and needs to be corrected in order to receive service.

Pack Out notes:
For an additional fee, customers can add Pack-Out service which enables sanitation crews to go onto private property (at an approved location) to provide collection service for City issued garbage/recycle roll cart(s). An application is required for this service.

All customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related Sanitation fees. 

Property Damage notes: 
Enter a Compliment/Complaint service request if also filing a complaint against the driver.

For damaged roll carts, enter a Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery service request.

Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery notes:
Only residential customers can request a new roll cart or addition/removal of a roll cart. All customers can request maintenance of an existing roll cart. See the Sanitation website for the latest fees for additional roll carts. The owner or occupant of a dwelling unit with one roll cart for recyclable materials may request one additional roll cart for recyclable materials with no additional fee applied. Dwelling units with two or more roll carts for recyclable materials may request additional roll carts for recyclable materials for a one-time processing and handling fee of $50.00 per roll cart, which will be applied to the dwelling unit’s water account.


City Code reference: Chapter 18 Municipal Solid Wastes
City codes can be accessed at the Dallas City Attorney website.

This program requires a petition signed by 2/3rd's of the property owners with 50% of the property frontage which will be sent to the customer if criteria are met. Property owners will share in the cost of the improvements. For replacement of existing deteriorated sidewalks, please use - 'Sidewalk Replacement' request.

serviceTypes.title: Sidewalk Replacement Construction
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report concerns regarding sidewalk replacement construction that is being performed through the citizen cost share replacement program.

serviceTypes.title: Sidewalk Replacement Program
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to request replacement of existing deteriorated sidewalks within public right-of-way. Sidewalks are the responsibility of the home owner. This is a cost share program between the City and the citizen. For RESIDENTIAL sidewalk replacement - NOT for Businesses.

serviceTypes.title: Sidewalk Violations Hazardous
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report sidewalk violations that are hazardous. Sidewalks are the responsibility of the property owner.

serviceTypes.title: Sign
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for reporting issues related to ADVERTISING signs for which there is, or should be, a permit. *** Please DO NOT USE for Trafic Signals or Traffic Signs ***

serviceTypes.title: Signs - Other
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report signs that are in violation of height, size or placement, signs on vacant businesses and/or signs on operable vehicles such as trucks, vans, cars and hot air balloons.

serviceTypes.title: Signs - Other Apts
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report signs that are in violation of height, size or placement, signs on vacant apartment complexes and/or signs on operable vehicles: trucks, vans, cars, hot air balloons.

serviceTypes.title: Signs - Political
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report political signs on private or public property, put up too soon (60 days before an election or still up 10 days after an election).

serviceTypes.title: Signs - Public Right Of Way
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a notice, poster, paper, or device, posted or affixed to any lamp post, utility pole, telephone pole, cellular telephone pole, or tree that is located on any public right of way or other public property, or to any public structure or building.

serviceTypes.title: Signs - Public Right Of Way Apts
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report illegally placed notices, posters, cardboard, paper signs, or device on the right of way (Parkway), median, utility poles or other public property in front of an apartment complex or condominium.

serviceTypes.title: Smoke Detector Request
serviceTypes.description: Use this request to inquire about a smoke detector for owner occupied single-family and duplex residences. This does not apply to rental occupancies such as apartments or rent houses.

serviceTypes.title: Smoking Ordinance
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report smoking in any City of Dallas owned or operated facility or office building. ** For Food Establishments, Bingo Halls or Snack Bars - use Smoking/Restaurant Complaint - CCS.

serviceTypes.title: Smoking/Restaurant Complaint
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report smoking complaints in restaurants, bars, food establishments, bingo halls or snack bars.

serviceTypes.title: Special Events Permit Request
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for any outdoor special events and commercial filming activity in the City of Dallas. This includes parades, foot races & street festivals. No permits issued for DCC or Fair Park.

serviceTypes.title: Speed Limit Change Request
serviceTypes.description: Use this request for changes in speed limits for streets within the Dallas city limits. For freeways please contact TXDOT.

serviceTypes.title: Storm Sewer Line Locate
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to request a storm line-locate. A storm line-locate is most often needed when construction requires a vertical bore or a horizontal bore. Any activity that requires digging near a street or easement should have a line-locate prior to digging. Line-locates are occasionally requested so that construction can plan where to connect a storm drain.

serviceTypes.title: Storm Water Construction Site
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report sediment, solid waste, and liquid or construction waste leaving a construction site.

serviceTypes.title: Street Lighting - Maintenance
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for street lights that are maintained or repaired by Oncor, for first time reports highlight and paste this link (https://www.oncorstreetlight.com) to enter the request directly onto their system. Continue request if previously reported.

serviceTypes.title: Street Lighting - New/Relocation
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to request street lighting where none has existed or to relocate an existing street light. ** Citizens contact information is required for this request. **

serviceTypes.title: Fair Park Facilities/Museums
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns regarding the fair, museum, and park facilities.

serviceTypes.title: Street Repair - Routine
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report minor street repairs such as base failures, push-ups, level-ups, standing water and broken curb and gutter.

serviceTypes.title: Street Sweeping
serviceTypes.description: Use this request to report sweeping needed on major thoroughfares ONLY. Street Services has a systematic cleaning schedule, which ensures coverage of the major traffic thoroughfares within the City of Dallas. Cleaning includes sweeping, flushing and cleaning of gutters. ** NOTE: Residential street sweeping is not provided, however, if it is a Hazard (glass or other debris) call 3-1-1 and city crews will respond. The Department of Street Services does not provide residential street sweeping. **

serviceTypes.title: Substandard Structure
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report occupied or unoccupied residential and commercial properties, detached garages, storage buildings or carports in need of repair, structures not in weather tight condition, including in need of paint, broken windows, torn screens or any other dilapidated condition.

serviceTypes.title: Substandard Structure Apts
serviceTypes.description: FOR APARTMENT USE ONLY - Use this service request for reporting occupied residential and commercial properties, detached garage, storage buildings or carports in need of repair, structures not in weather tight condition, including in need of paint, broken windows, torn screens or any other dilapidated condition at an Apartment.

serviceTypes.title: Survey Questions
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request type to request surveyed information on a City of Dallas public right-of-way.

serviceTypes.title: Swimming Pool Discharge
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request type to report the draining of swimming pools, hot tubs, or ponds into the alley or storm drain system.

serviceTypes.title: Taxi - Transportation Complaint
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report for complaints related to taxicabs, drivers, and companies. Your name and phone number is required to continue with this request.

serviceTypes.title: Traffic - Construction Signs
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a problem with signage at construction sites on City of Dallas streets. (Ex. - signs that may be missing, moved or knocked over or signs that were left at a construction site once work has been completed.)

serviceTypes.title: Traffic - General Request
serviceTypes.description: Use this request to inquire about the installation of new signs, signals and markings that have never existed - signs, traffic markings, signals, road humps, speed bumps, no parking, alley rumble strips, etc. It is also for the maintenance of existing signs with the exception of Stop Signs, Yield Signs, and One Way Signs that are down. Those should be called in immediately to 311. For any concerns regarding the Red Light Camera Program call 1-866-247-1951.

serviceTypes.title: Traffic - Road Hump Request
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to inquire about road humps or speed bumps. A study, petition and fees may be involved if requesting new humps or bumps. This request requires a name, address and phone number.

serviceTypes.title: Traffic - Rumble Strip Maintenance (Alley Spd Hump)
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report maintenance issues on alley rumble strips. A name, address and daytime phone are required for this request.

serviceTypes.title: Traffic - Rumble Strips New (Alley Spd Hump)
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to request new rumble strips in the alley. There is a cost . This request requires a name, address and daytime phone number. ** If strips need maintenance use - Traffic - Rumble Strip Maintenance SR. **

serviceTypes.title: Traffic - Street Closure
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request if a permanent street closure is requested. A petition is involved and contact information is required to process request.

serviceTypes.title: Traffic Markings - Maintenance
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for maintenance on all traffic markings for city streets. serviceTypes.title: Traffic Signal - School Flasher New
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns regarding installation of a new school flasher and existing flashers that need to be removed. **** IMPORTANT - Please enter school flasher requests with a block number and street name. ****

serviceTypes.title: Traffic Violations - Chronic (Evenings)
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for all traffic complaints of a chronic or recurring nature occurring: Monday -Friday after 7pm and on Weekends, such as speeding, red light /traffic sign violations and street racing.

serviceTypes.title: Tree Removal
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report the illegal removal of "protected" trees from public and/or private property or a "protected" tree that is endangered by construction.

serviceTypes.title: Trinity Corridor Project
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report issues and concerns or inquire about Trinity Corridor Projects.

serviceTypes.title: Trinity River Levee Mowing/Maintenance - Routine
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report that the Trinity River Levee or Retention/Detention Basin needs mowing. This is the responsibility of the Trinity Watershed Management Department.

serviceTypes.title: Trinity Watershed Management General
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for general Trinity Watershed Management issues and concerns.

serviceTypes.title: Utility Complaint/Information
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns related to utility complaints or utility information.

serviceTypes.title: Utility Cut/Routine
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report excavation concerns about cuts made in street, alley or sidewalk that are not hazardous. This includes any concerns about construction activity in the public R-O-W, specifically utility excavations and or damage, caused during the process. ** Utility Cuts are generally - SQUARE, if other please complete a Street Repair - Routine SR. If it is an emergency or hazardous, call 311. **

serviceTypes.title: Visibility Obstruction
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report any visibility obstructions that are caused when a vehicle cannot see oncoming traffic due to overgrown vegetation, shrubs, grass or low hanging limbs. ** If a traffic sign or signal is obstructed please Call 3-1-1 for assistance. **

serviceTypes.title: Water Conservation Violation
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report water conservation violations, such as, watering during any form of precipitation; operating an irrigation system with broken or missing sprinkler heads (that lead to substantial amount of water on sidewalks, driveways & streets), watering a landscape or lawn in a manner that wastes water or causes runoff. Watering lawns or landscapes is prohibited (except by a hand held hose), between the hours of 10 a.m. and 6 p.m., from April 1- October 31.

serviceTypes.title: Water Conservation Violation Apts
serviceTypes.description: FOR APARTMENTS ONLY - Use to report a water conservation complaint where water is being wasted such as watering a sidewalk/driveway. Watering during any form of precipitation, operating an irrigation system with broken or missing sprinkler heads or one that is poorly maintained and leads to water waste. Watering a landscape or lawn in a manner that wastes water or causes runoff. Watering lawns or landscapes is prohibited (except by hand held hose) between the hours of 10am & 6pm frm 4/1 to 10/31.

serviceTypes.title: Water Payments & Billing Inquiry
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request if you have a question regarding your monthly water bill statement or payments made to your account. ** Do Not Use For: Restoration of service, service discontinuance, new service or theft of water. Please call Customer Service at 214-651-1441. For questions about garbage pickup call 311. **

serviceTypes.title: Water Pollution Routine - Creek, Lake,River
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report pollution in a creek, lake,or river.

serviceTypes.title: Water Questions
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request if you have a general request or concern related to water that is NOT an emergency. *** DO NOT USE FOR: water quality, stopped sewer, sewer overflow, main or main leaks, theft of water, service restoration, service discontinuance, or any dangerous situation. Please contact 214-651-1441 for those requests. ***
serviceTypes.details:
Use to report a general request or concern related to Water.

 

ERT: 2 business days
SLA: 2 business days

This request is for non-emergencies and it is not for routine Water calls (payments, service discontinuance, water quality, . . .).

Do not use this request for emergencies (main break, burst pipes, leaks doing property damage, . . .).

serviceTypes.title: Wheel Chair Ramp/Curb Cuts
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns regarding the installation of a Wheel Chair Ramp, Curb Cut, or Barrier Free Ramp at an intersection.

serviceTypes.title: Yard Waste
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report the dumping and blowing of yard debris such as grass clippings and leaves into the street, alley, creek, lake, river or storm drain/inlet.

serviceTypes.title: Ambulance - Transportation Complaint
serviceTypes.description: Use to request regulation of a ambulance driver or company and request permits for ambulances. Citizen MUST provide name and phone number on this request type.

serviceTypes.title: Sustainable Development And Construction General
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request type for miscellaneous Sustainable Development and Construction issues or concerns that do not fit in any other known service request type.

serviceTypes.title: Sanitation Compliment/Complaint
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request type to report compliments and complaints concerning Sanitation personnel and the department. Obtain vehicle number and license plate of vehicle, time and location of incident. This DOES NOT include property damage; for damage to property as a result of Sanitation personnel or equipment, use Sanitation Property Damage.

serviceTypes.title: Paving - Unimproved (New Street)
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to request concrete street paving of an unimproved street that does NOT have existing curbs and gutters. This program requires a petition signed by 2/3rd's of the property owners with 50% of the property frontage which will be sent to the customer if criteria are met. Property owners will share in the cost of the street improvements. ** If you are requesting repairs or repaving of a street that already has concrete or is paved please use the 'Street Repair - Routine' service request. **

serviceTypes.title: Garbage Roll Cart - Residential
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report RESIDENTIAL garbage roll carts that are broken and need to be replaced or repaired. This service request can also be used to request new or additional garbage roll carts or to remove extra garbage roll carts. *If this is pertaining to a Business/Commercial, requests should be submitted using the Garbage Roll Cart - Commercial service request.

serviceTypes.title: Animal - Noisy
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report excessive or loud barking or crying pets that is disturbing to neighbors. YOUR NAME, ADDRESS AND PHONE NUMBER ARE REQUIRED TO ISSUE A COMPLAINT.

serviceTypes.title: Sanitation Misc.
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request to report or request general concerns related to garbage, brush/bulk items and composting. To report water leaks, water main breaks, leaking/stopped sewers, or other Water related problems, please contact 311.

serviceTypes.title: Construction Rest Break
serviceTypes.description: Use this Service Request to report violations related to the Construction Rest Break Ordinance.

serviceTypes.title: Limousine - Transportation Complaint
serviceTypes.description: Use to request regulation of a limousine driver or company and request permits for limousines. Citizen MUST provide name and phone number on this request type.

serviceTypes.title: Water/Wastewater Line Locate - Scs
serviceTypes.description: ** FOR BUSINESS/COMMERCIAL USE ONLY ** - Use this to request a scheduled water/wastewater line locate from Dallas Water Utilities. ** Be advised only ONE location per SR is allowed. If water lines are 'outside' the city of Dallas please call 3-1-1. NOT for RESIDENTIAL USE **

serviceTypes.title: Storm Brush - Debris
serviceTypes.description: This service request is for residents affected by an immediate storm event caused by heavy rains, thunderstorms, winds, ice, etc. and have debris in your YARD as a result of the storm.  NOTE: This service request will be used for Sanitation crews to assess the extent of damage and determine where their efforts are most needed.  DO NOT USE this request for downed trees, electrical lines or power outages...this is for STORM DEBRIS ONLY!!!

serviceTypes.title: Traffic Violations - (Chronic)
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request for all traffic complaints of a chronic or recurring nature for the listed days and times: Monday - Friday 6am - 7pm, such as speeding, red light and school zone violations. For ALL other days and times use: TRAFFIC VIOLATIONS -Chronic (EVENINGS). Not for parking violations.
serviceTypes.details:
Use to report traffic violations that reoccur, such as speeding, using cell phones in an active school zone, street racing and red light/traffic sign violations at/in a specific area or location.

ERT: 5 business days
SLA: 17 business days

Do not use this request for parking violations.

For emergencies, call 911.

serviceTypes.title: Feed The Homeless Location
serviceTypes.description: Use this Service Request to track homeless feeding notifications in the City of Dallas

serviceTypes.title: Erosion
serviceTypes.description: Use this service request if there is Erosion occurring on a creek bank, dam or retention wall threatening a property or structure. EROSION is the breakdown of land around you; causing the earth to wear away and dissolve...this is often caused by water, wind or ice.

serviceTypes.title: Garbage Roll Cart - Commercial
serviceTypes.description: This service request is ONLY for BUSINESS/COMMERCIAL customers requesting a Repair or Replacement Garbage Roll Cart....for a New or Additional cart or to Remove an Extra Cart, please contact the Sanitation Department at: 214-670-3555.

ERT: 3 business days

ERT: 3 business days

knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to report physical barriers or constraints within City programs, services, activities, or facilities (i.e., participation or communication concerns for public programs, services, or activities; inaccessible, missing, or damaged pedestrian elements such as pedestrian signals, crossings, sidewalks, or curb ramps; or access barriers for/at/in a city facility or park).


ERT: 5 business days
SLA: 30 business days

knowledgeArticles.title: School Crossing Guard – SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to request a school crossing guard, report a crossing guard absent from a post or to report complaints, compliments and concerns related to school crossing guards.

ERT: 3 business days
SLA: 6 business days
knowledgeArticles.details:
Some examples of complaints or concerns include:
employee conduct
safety issues
information about the program

knowledgeArticles.title: Motor Vehicle Idling – SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to report trucks idling at truck stops and warehouses.


ERT: 1 business day
SLA: 4 business days
knowledgeArticles.details: The applicable ordinance prohibits vehicles weighing more than 14,000 pounds from idling for more than five minutes within Dallas city limits.

knowledgeArticles.title: Landlord Retaliation After Reported Code Violation – SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to report retaliatory actions by a landlord/owner after a Code violation was reported.

ERT: 13 business days
SLA: 17 business days
knowledgeArticles.details:
Some examples of retaliation following a report of violation include:
decreased or diminished services
access to amenities
increased rent
eviction

knowledgeArticles.title: Illegal Dumping Sign – SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to apply for a sign to prohibit illegal dumping of trash, garbage and solid waste.


ERT: 10 business days
SLA: 10 business days

knowledgeArticles.title: Water/Wastewater Line Locate - SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to request a routine water/wastewater line locate from Dallas Water Utilities. 

ERT: 1 business day
SLA: 1 business day
knowledgeArticles.details:
Only one location per service request is allowed.
 
If water lines are outside the city of Dallas, call 811.

knowledgeArticles.title: Water Questions – SR Descriptions
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to report a general request or concern related to Water.

 

ERT: 2 business days
SLA: 2 business days
knowledgeArticles.details:
This request is for non-emergencies and it is not for routine Water calls (payments, service discontinuance, water quality, . . .).

Do not use this request for emergencies (main break, burst pipes, leaks doing property damage, . . .).

knowledgeArticles.title: Complaint/Compliment - SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to make a complaint or compliment regarding a service request, a City of Dallas department, or an employee..

 

ERT: 2 business days
SLA: 10 business days
knowledgeArticles.details: If the concern is about a service request, allow 30 days from the time the service request is closed to report the same issue.

knowledgeArticles.title: 311 Event Request - SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to request the 311 City Hall on the Go van and team or a 311 guest speaker at an event.

ERT: 2 business days
SLA: 5 business days
knowledgeArticles.details:
The 311 City Hall on the Go vehicle is outfitted with computers and equipment so that staff can assist customers in accessing online City services and information. The objective is to take City services to the community, particularly in locations that are geographically distant from City Hall or communities that may not be familiar will all the services the City offers.

For more information or to request an event or guest speaker, send email to cityhallonthego@dallas.gov.

knowledgeArticles.title: Interagency Projects – SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to contact the department responsible for providing engineering and construction coordination on City of Dallas transportation projects involving other government agencies (DART, TXDOT, Dallas County, Collin County, and the NTTA).

ERT: 3 business days
SLA: 3 business days

knowledgeArticles.title: Construction Right of Way Status Inquiry – SR Description
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use to inquire about the status of ongoing construction or to report concerns regarding ongoing construction in a public right of way (street, alley or sidewalk).

ERT: 7 business days
SLA: 14 business days
knowledgeArticles.details: Construction should be actively in progress.

knowledgeArticles.title: Sanitation Requests – SR Descriptions
knowledgeArticles.description:
Use Annual 20 Cubic Yard Exemption to request exemption for oversize collection of brush/bulk debris. SLA: 1 business day

Use Sanitation Commercial Services to request new roll cart services and/or dumpster service, make changes to existing commercial service, or cancel service. ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 10 business days
 
Use Cost Plus to request on-demand collection of various brush and/or bulk solid waste materials.  ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Use Helping Hands to initiate/cancel/renew garbage and recycle collection assistance. ERT: 5 business days   SLA: 20 business days

Use Litter Cans  issues concerning the service of litter cans. ERT: 1 business days   SLA: 5 business days
 
Use Missed collections requests to report a missed collection.

Recycle & Garbage ERT: 2 business days    SLA: 3 business days
Brush/Bulk ERT: 2 business days   SLA: 7 business days

Use Pack Out to request pack out service. ERT: 3 business days   SLA: 5 business days

Use Property Damage to report damage to property caused by Sanitation trucks. ERT: 3 business days  SLA: 10 business days

Use Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery to request repair, replacement, or delivery of roll carts. ERT: 2 business days   SLA: 5 business days
knowledgeArticles.details:
Annual 20 Cubic Yard Exemption notes:
The service request must be submitted the week prior to the scheduled brush/bulk collection week. An excessive fee of $60 per five cubic yards may apply if applicable limits are exceeded. A resident may also be subject to a citation by Code Compliance for violating the limit.

Sanitation Commercial Services notes: 
An active Dallas Water Utilities account is required to proceed with this request. Businesses, City facilities, and multi-family properties can request commercial roll cart services. Only City facilities can request dumpster service. Residents in a multi-family property will be approved on a case-by-case basis. A signed CSA (commercial service agreement) must be obtained to provide/continue commercial service. 
 
Cost Plus notes:
Estimates are no longer provided by the Sanitation Districts. A minimum fee of $60 plus tax will be directly billed to the associated Dallas Water Utilities for services rendered but is subject to increase based upon the cubic yard load size. Items must be placed at the front curb or parkway (no alley or back pickup) within 24 hours of submitting.

Citizens needing to dispose of cost plus items can also take them to the landfill or one of the three transfer stations.

Helping Hands notes: 
A Helping Hands Program application and Declaration of Special Need form must be completed, signed, and returned to Sanitation headquarters for review and approval. Customers who do not have an able bodied person living in the residence that can relocate their roll cart(s) to the point of collection may be eligible for the Helping Hands Program at no additional cost. 
 
All customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related Sanitation fees being billed. 

Litter Cans notes: 
Litter cans are the metal containers found on the median at a stop light or on the sidewalk in front of a business.
 
If the litter can is at a DART Station or DART bus stop, contact DART. 
 
Missed Recycle & Missed Garbage notes:
Sanitation has until 8pm to pick up items.

Missed Bulk/Brush notes:
Sanitation has until 6pm on the Friday of the scheduled collection week to pick up items. Commercial accounts are not currently serviced for brush/bulky collections.

Missed collections notes (all collections):
An orange tag at the collection location indicates that a collection violation was identified and needs to be corrected in order to receive service.

Pack Out notes:
For an additional fee, customers can add Pack-Out service which enables sanitation crews to go onto private property (at an approved location) to provide collection service for City issued garbage/recycle roll cart(s). An application is required for this service.

All customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related Sanitation fees. 

Property Damage notes: 
Enter a Compliment/Complaint service request if also filing a complaint against the driver.

For damaged roll carts, enter a Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery service request.

Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery notes:
Only residential customers can request a new roll cart or addition/removal of a roll cart. All customers can request maintenance of an existing roll cart. See the Sanitation website for the latest fees for additional roll carts. The owner or occupant of a dwelling unit with one roll cart for recyclable materials may request one additional roll cart for recyclable materials with no additional fee applied. Dwelling units with two or more roll carts for recyclable materials may request additional roll carts for recyclable materials for a one-time processing and handling fee of $50.00 per roll cart, which will be applied to the dwelling unit’s water account.


City Code reference: Chapter 18 Municipal Solid Wastes

portalServiceTypes.title: Alley/Sidewalk/Street Repair - Hazardous

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Aggressive Behavior
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report animal attacks, aggressive activity and aggressive pack activity on public or private property, school grounds, and day care centers. Service requests of this nature are dispatched and responded to based on priority. Priority 1: Instances in which a dog is attacking a domestic animal or livestock, an attack on a human and vice versa is currently in progress, or high-risk dogs are active near children or locations during operating hours where children are commonly present (example: schools, daycare facilities and parks) will be responded to within 1 hour. Priority 3: Instances in which two or more dogs act together as an aggressive pack will be responded to within 4 hours. Priority 4: Other instances of loose aggressive dogs will be responded to within 6 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Bite
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report that someone has been bitten or scratched by an animal. This service request can be entered whether or not the animal is owned. Veterinary clinics requesting rabies testing specimens may also enter their requests here due to them being bite related. Service requests of this nature are dispatched and responded to based on priority. Priority 3: Instances in which the biting animal remains loose will be responded to within 4 hours. Priority 3: Instances in which the biting animal has been contained will be responded to within 4 hours. Priority 5: Instances of rabies specimen pickups from Veterinary clinics will be responded to within 12 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Community Cat Nuisance
portalServiceTypes.description: Complaints involving community cats, including sanitation and noise concerns.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Community Cat Spay/Neuter Services
portalServiceTypes.description: Requests for services related to community cats, including spay/neuter surgery and vaccinations. This request type should be used when a resident is seeking veterinary services for community cats rather than reporting a nuisance or complaint.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Confined
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report confined stray animals, animals confined in vehicles or the bed of a truck, and animals trapped in culverts/drains/pipes. Residents are responsible for the animals they confine and will be held responsible for ensuring they are kept out of the sun/rain and given food and water during confinement. Animals that can be safely transported can be brought to the animal shelter at 1818 N Westmoreland Rd during normal business hours. Visit https://dallascityhall.com/departments/dallas-animal-services/Pages/default.aspx for more details. Service requests of this nature are dispatched and responded to based on priority. Priority 2: Instances in which there exists an immediate threat to the life of the animal will be responded to within 2 hours. Priority 3: Instances in which an animal is confined within living quarters and is also of a species that commonly carries rabies (bats, coyotes, foxes, raccoons and skunks) will be responded to within 4 hours. Priority 5: Other instances of confined animals will be responded to within 12 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Illegal Vending
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report the illegal sale of any animals on public property and the illegal sale of dogs, cats, or exotic animals on private property. Priority 8: Instances will be responded to within 18 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Lack of Care
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report animals that are sick, injured, in critical condition, left in extreme temperatures, or lacking care (food, water, shelter, etc.). Service requests of this nature are dispatched and responded to based on priority. Priority 2: Instances in which there exists an immediate threat to the life of an animal (domestic or wildlife) will be responded to within 2 hours. Priority 2: Instances in which an animal is subjected to temperatures below 32 degrees Fahrenheit or a heat advisory has been issued will be responded to within 2 hours. Priority 4: Instances in which an animal is sick or has a non-life-threatening injury will be responded to within 6 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Loose
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report animals that are unrestrained and currently beyond the boundaries of the property owned, leased or legally occupied by the animal’s owner. Service requests of this nature are dispatched and responded to based on priority. Priority 1: Instances in which an animal is located on a roadway will be responded to within 1 hour. Priority 6: Instances in which a non-aggressive animal of known ownership is loose will be responded to within 24 hours. Priority 8: Instances of non-aggressive stray animals will be responded to within 24 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Animal Nuisance
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report common nuisance animal offenses. Initial complaints will result in correspondence to the owner and the complainant (if they provide address) to educate them on the violation and the next steps. Owners are given up to 3 weeks to comply. If Dallas Animal Services receives additional complaints after the compliance date, there will be an investigation. Priority 8: Instances will be responded to within 15 Business Days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Construction Right of Way/Status Inquiry
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to inquire about the status of ongoing construction or to report concerns about ongoing construction in the public right of way (i.e. street, alley or sidewalk) by private contractors or by the City of Dallas. Construction should be actively in progress. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 7 business days.

knowledgeArticleMatches.title: Construction Right of Way Status Inquiry – SR Description

portalServiceTypes.title: Construction Site Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for issues and concerns caused by construction sites, such as trash and debris left behind by construction crews, no erosion control, and mud being tracked into the street. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Consumer Protection Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report consumer protection concerns pertaining to credit lenders and payday loan facilities. Complaints against electronic and motor vehicle repair shops. Concerns related to repairs and work performed in your home. Violations related to scrap tire enforcement (i.e., mobile tire repair, tire repair shops, transporting tires), violations against wood vendors (i.e., businesses that sell and deliver wood used for fire and fuel), The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Creek Bank Erosion
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request if there is Erosion occurring on a creek bank, dam or retention wall threatening a property or structure. Erosion is the breakdown of land around you; causing the earth to wear away and dissolve...this is often caused by water, wind or ice. The estimated response time (ERT) for this request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Creek/Culvert Blockage
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report problems with culverts or creeks. The maintenance of creeks, drainage ways, channels and streams are the responsibility of the property owner. The Water Department is responsible for maintaining creeks and drainage ways that are owned by the City of Dallas only. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Creek/Culvert Maintenance
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a concrete lined or earthen channel that has sediment and debris in it which can impede or block the flow of water (potential risk of flooding). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 14 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Dallas Bond Program Projects
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for general inquiries concerning Dallas Bond Program Projects. ** For questions regarding the 2017 Bond Program Click Here For updates on the upcoming 2024 Bond Projects Click Here ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 15 business days. Note: For construction concerns or construction site complaints, see Code Concern (Noise Complaint) or Construction Site Complaint.

portalServiceTypes.title: Drainage Ditch Cleaning and Repair
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a drainage ditch that needs to be cleaned or repaired. ** If conditions of drainage ditch appears hazardous please Call 3-1-1 for immediate assistance ** Do not use for Inlets/Storm Drains. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 14 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Emerald Ash Borer Information Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report ash trees potentially infested with Emerald Ash Borers and/or to request information about Emerald Ash Borer management. The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Fair Housing Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this Service Request to report complaints related to discriminatory practices in the sale, rental and financing of properties based on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, etc. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

details.label: DEPARTMENT
details.value: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment

portalServiceTypes.department: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment

portalServiceTypes.title: File a Complaint or Commendation – Community Police Oversight
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this 311 service request to submit a complaint or commendation regarding a member of the Dallas Police Department (DPD). *** FILE A COMPLAINT: If you wish to file a complaint against a DPD employee, please complete the complaint form HERE. If you are unsure of the officer’s name or badge number, please provide the date, time, and details of the incident so we can identify the officer(s) involved. *** COMMEND AN OFFICER: If you would like to recognize a DPD employee for outstanding service, please complete the commendation form HERE. NOTE: Criminal complaints against individuals who are not part of the Dallas Police Department must be filed directly with the Dallas Police Department. For those who would like to file a commendation or complaint in person or by mail, additional information is available on the OCPO website.

portalServiceTypes.title: Fire Department Educational Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request fire safety educational programs only. Requests to visit a fire station or to have an engine on location must be submitted to the following email address: dfrshowandtell@dallasfire.gov. The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Fire Inspection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request a fire inspection. The estimated response time for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Fireworks
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report instances where fireworks are being used inside the city limits. Service requests of this nature are responded to based on priority and are usually resolved within 1- 3 days. ** Call 911 if this is a life threatening emergency. **

portalServiceTypes.title: Flooded Roadway Warning System
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a high water sign or location needing maintenance or repair. NOTE: There are 42 Flooding Roadway Warning Systems high water locations throughout the City of Dallas. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Flooding Emergency
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report hazardous/emergency flooding conditions. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Floodplain/Stormwater Project Inquiry
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for miscellaneous issues or concerns regarding floodplain construction projects. This request can also be used for customers requesting a new storm drain to be installed. The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Food Borne Illness
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report sickness from eating at any food establishment, vending machine, or school within the Dallas City limits. A name and phone number are required to process this request. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Graffiti on City Streets & Bridges
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report graffiti on sidewalks, alleys, bridges, retaining walls and/or streets only. For graffiti on major freeways contact TXDOT. Private property is the owner's responsibility. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 7 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Graffiti Traffic Sign
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report graffiti on traffic signs. The estimated response time (ERT) for this request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Guardrail Maintenance
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report damages to existing guardrails or treated posts. If the damages could pose a Hazardous condition that could be detrimental to vehicular or pedestrian traffic, please dial 3-1-1. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Guardrail New
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to inquire about new guardrails for Dallas city roadways. For maintenance on guardrails - use Guardrail Repair - Routine. **Guardrails on the freeway are handled by TXDOT. Guardrails on private property are the owner's responsibility. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Guardrail Repair Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a hazardous guardrail in need of repair under emergency circumstances, i.e. rail knocked down, missing causing high fall risk, damaged metal protruding into right of way. **Freeways are the responsibility of Texas Dept of Transportation ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Handicap Parking Violation
categoryNames: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report handicap parking violations at a business. Not for use in requesting handicap parking signs. ** Vehicle information is required to complete SR ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: High Water Flooded Roadway Alarm Warning System
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a problem with the high water sign systems if the lights are NOT flashing when water is ON the road and if the lights are still flashing after water has receded. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Historic District Violation
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report structures that do not comply with the historic district preservation criteria. Historic districts are a type of zoning district designation that helps to preserve and protect the character of Dallas architecturally unique neighborhoods. If this is a substandard structure in a Historical or Conservation District please use report it to Code Compliance. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 2 business days

portalServiceTypes.title: Homeless Encampment
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a temporary structure being used as an overnight shelter or to report unsheltered individuals living/sleeping in vehicles, on sidewalks, under bridges, etc. DO NOT enter request for individuals trespassing in abandoned buildings, panhandling, squatting, etc. Trespassing concerns should be reported to 911; and reports for panhandling should be submitted as a Panhandling service request to the Police Department. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

details.label: DEPARTMENT
details.value: Office of Emergency Management and Crisis Response

portalServiceTypes.department: Office of Emergency Management and Crisis Response

portalServiceTypes.title: Housing & Neighborhood Revitalization
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request assistance or information related to home repair, Dallas Home Assistance Program, first time home buyers program, or the Major System Repair Program (roofing, electrical, plumbing/gas, and HVAC.) The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.
