details.value: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment

portalServiceTypes.department: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment

portalServiceTypes.title: Illegal Dumping Sign
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to apply for a sign to prohibit illegal dumping of trash, garbage and solid waste. The estimated response time for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Illegal Dumping Urgent
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report abandoned/illegally dumped drums or containers or leaves, grass clippings, yard and garden debris, and/or brush that has been deliberately dumped/blown into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Illegal Removal of Protected Tree
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report the illegal removal of protected trees from public and/or private property or a protected tree that is endangered by construction. Property owners are responsible for the removal of trees that are not protected. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 3 business days.

knowledgeArticleMatches.title: Illegal Removal of Protected Tree – SR Description

portalServiceTypes.title: Illegal Spray Painting
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report illegal spray painting by commercial businesses that are not using the proper painting booth, causing vapors to go into the neighborhood where applying flammable or combustible coatings onto products is an integral part of their work process without benefit of an approved spray booth, spray room, or spray area. Do not use for individual spray painting, reporting graffiti or tagging. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Increased Criminal Activities
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report complaints of reoccurring criminal offenses such as burglaries, thefts, and criminal mischief's in a particular neighborhood that have been reported. MUST provide day/time of activity, exact location, and a description of individual(s) involved. Note: If reporting a crime that is occurring or that has just occurred - CALL 9-1-1. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Increased Police Patrol
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request when a citizen would like to request additional police patrol in their neighborhood or a specific Dallas area. If there are specific days and times please provide. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Inlet/Storm Drain Cleaning
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report an inlet or storm drain that needs cleaning. Water Utilities is responsible for the maintenance of underground storm sewer main lines, inlet boxes and lateral lines on public property and drainage easements throughout the City of Dallas. Water Utilities is also responsible for the removal of any obstruction in culverts under City maintained streets and alleys. The City of Dallas does not provide cleaning of private property. If this request is regarding an animal, personal items or smoke in the inlet/storm drain, please call 311 for immediate assistance. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

knowledgeArticleMatches.title: Inlet Storm Drain Cleaning - SR Description

portalServiceTypes.title: Inlet/Storm Drain Stopped Up - Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report an inlet/storm drain that is stopped up and creating hazardous condition. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Interagency Projects
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to contact the department responsible for providing engineering and construction coordination on City of Dallas transportation projects involving other governmental agencies (DART, TXDOT, Dallas County, Collin County, and the NTTA). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days. For additional information Click Here

portalServiceTypes.title: Landlord Retaliation After Reported Code Violation
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report retaliatory actions by a landlord/Owner after a Code violation was reported, i.e., complaints of decreased or diminished services, access to amenities, increased rent, eviction, etc. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 13 business days.

knowledgeArticleMatches.title: Landlord Retaliation After Reported Code Violation – SR Description

portalServiceTypes.title: Landscaping Violation
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report landscaping violations of the Dallas City Code Landscaping Requirements (Article X). This service request routes to the Arborist Division of the Planning and Development Department. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 5 business days. Visit Article X for more information: https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/dallas/latest/dallas_tx/0-0-0-91946

portalServiceTypes.title: Library Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report concerns regarding building/property maintenance and library/employee services at City of Dallas libraries. For additional information please visit our website at www.dallaslibrary.org. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Lid Cover Broken (Storm Sewer/Manhole)
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a broken sewer/manhole lid cover. The department will investigate to determine the type of lid cover. ** If issue appears hazardous please call 3-1-1 ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Lid Cover Broken/Missing (Storm Sewer Manhole) - Hazardous
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request type to report a broken or missing inlet cover, inlet grate, or storm sewer manhole cover that is broken, and may pose a potential hazard to pedestrian or vehicular traffic. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Lock or Unlock Knox Lock/Box
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request to have a Knox Company emergency lock or box opened or locked by Dallas Fire personnel. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Locked/Blocked Exit
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request in any situation where a required exit door, exit window or exit pathway, including stairwells and stairways, are blocked or locked. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Median/Right of Way Maintenance
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request type to report routine maintenance of shrubs, trees, trimming and mowing on City of Dallas medians or rights-of-way (median, triangles, and traffic circles). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Mobile Food Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for reporting food violations concerning push carts, ice cream trucks, catering trucks, and food preparation trucks (hot trucks) or any food stand. If regarding food poisoning or food related illnesses call 3-1-1. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Mosquito - Do Not Spray
portalServiceTypes.description: This Service Request is used to document residents who DO NOT wish to have Mosquito Spraying at their address (this does not include the entire block or area). Once submitted, your address will be placed on the “Do Not Spray” list, please allow up to 48 hours for your address to appear on this list. You will need to renew your request each year that you wish to be on the list. Yard signs are also available to identify a residence as a "Do Not Spray" Address. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Mosquito Beekeeper Notification
portalServiceTypes.description: This Service Request is used to COLLECT Beekeeper contact information. A Beekeeper is defined as a person who keeps, raises, and cares for honeybees. This Service Request will allow the City of Dallas to provide "notification" to Beekeepers before ground and aerial spraying take place for mosquito abatement. The City of Dallas does not respond to complaints regarding bees, please contact a private exterminator for pest control. If the concern is regarding mosquitoes, please submit a Code Concern Service Request Type (and select pest/bugs). The estimated response time for this service request is 48 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Motor Vehicle Idling
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report trucks idling at truck stops and warehouses. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: MOWmentum Program
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to receive information to adopt a Median, Right-of-way, Triangle or traffic circle for beautification, parkways not eligible. The MOWmentum Program is designed to allow homeowner association groups, businesses and individuals an opportunity to adopt a portion of the public right-of-way for the purposes of maintaining and improving the property. **Adopt a Roadside is handled by TXDOT ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Narcotics/Vice Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report possible drug houses/locations where drugs are being sold, prostitution and illegal gambling complaints. Information regarding the time of day activity occurs, actual day(s) it occurs, location and persons involved is required to investigate. Contact information for further questions is recommended to process request. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: New Alley/Sidewalk/Street Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request concrete paving of an unimproved alley (made of gravel or dirt), an unimproved street (that does not have existing curbs and gutters) or the installation of sidewalks. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Noise Complaint (Residential)
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report noise complaints of a chronic or reoccurring nature, i.e. continuous complaints about loud music/disturbances at a residential property. **Do not use to report noisy animals, construction noise or noise issues at clubs/bars. See Animal - Noisy or Code Concern ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days. *** Call 9-1-1 if this is the first-time reporting the location or if the noise is occurring now ***

portalServiceTypes.title: Objects Dropped in Inlet/Storm Drain - Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report objects dropped in the inlet or storm drain. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Occupancy Load Violation (Commercial/Business)
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report an occupancy load violation such as too many people in a nightclub, bar, restaurant or other public location where the number of people is more than what is allowed by the certificate of occupancy of the business. Not for residential use. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Panhandling
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report complaints of recurring panhandling at a specific location. A description of the individual, location and day(s) and time of activity is needed. Note: Call 9-1-1 for aggressive panhandlers. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Park Maintenance/Misc
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report any concerns regarding the maintenance of parks, trails, athletic fields, recreation centers and special non-park properties. This request can also be used to report concerns regarding restrooms, pavilions, playground/picnic equipment, and other structures in the park. The estimated response time for this service request is 7 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Parking in Fire Lane/Fire Hydrants
categoryNames: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report vehicles that are parked in marked fire lanes or vehicles parked on the street within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

catalogMatches.title: Parking In Fire Lane/ Fire Hydrants

portalServiceTypes.title: Parking Report a Violation
categoryNames: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report parking violations on a public street, alley or sidewalk. Please use block numbers when entering vehicle location (i.e. 1300 Main). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 4 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Paving Reconstruction Project
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to inquire about the status of an alley, street, or thoroughfare reconstruction project being performed by the city or for complaints regarding a city reconstruction project taking place. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 8 business days. *** City projects have an 'informational' sign in the project area detailing the project ***

portalServiceTypes.title: Pay Lot Booting
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report complaints regarding vehicles that have been booted on a private lot. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Pot Hole - Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a hazardous pot hole located in the alley or street. A location is considered a hazard if it has the potential to cause serious damage to vehicles or pedestrians. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 12 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Pot Hole - Routine Repair
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report routine pothole repairs. A routine pothole is a hole in the pavement that is 3 feet by 3 feet in diameter or less. Please indicate where the pothole is located - in the street or alley. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Private Development Coordination
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to review private engineering plans and contracts for private development within a City of Dallas public right-of-way and or easement or questions regarding construction in the listed areas. For information, contact Private Development Coordination at 214-948-4205. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Railroad Crossing Repair
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report concerns regarding railroad crossings in need of repair - i.e. rough railroad crossings. Call 9-1-1 for malfunctioning railroad signals. Contact DART for DART train/rail crossings. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 7 business days. **** Please be advised that the City of Dallas does not have jurisdiction over maintenance of railroads. They are owned, operated and maintained by the rail/railroad owner and notified accordingly. ****

portalServiceTypes.title: Report Storm Brush/Debris
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report storm debris at a residence as the result of a recent storm event including heavy rains, thunderstorms, winds, ice, etc. This service request is used by Sanitation Services to assess the extent of the damage and determine where their efforts are most needed. This service request should only be used for storm brush and debris, please do not enter downed trees, electrical lines, or power outages here. If a tree or limb is blocking the street or alley please report your concern to public works. Depending upon Sanitation's assessment, storm debris MAY be picked up before OR during the normal bulk trash pickup week. Pick up before the normal bulk trash pickup week and holds on bulk trash citations are not guaranteed. Residents are encouraged to visit the City's landfill, transfer stations, or private haulers may also be hired at the resident's discretion and expense to avoid a bulk trash citation from Code Compliance.

portalServiceTypes.title: Resident Only - Parking Permit Request
categoryNames: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to apply for a residential parking only permit: 1) due to parking congestion or 2) for Deep Ellum residents. Permits available only in certain areas for single family dwellings and Deep Ellum. ** Requestor must provide contact information ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 30 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Restaurant/Food Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for turning in complaints on restaurants in the City limits of Dallas that have a roach problem, improper food temperature, dirty dishes, dirty bathrooms, no hot water in the restrooms, and the overall sanitary conditions of the restaurant. Also use for food complaints at convenience stores, grocery stores, schools, lunch trucks, and ice cream trucks where prepared food is sold. The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sand Removal Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request sand pick up after a snow/ice event. Major thoroughfares and bus routes are swept immediately after the snow/ice event. Secondary thoroughfares are swept within 30 days after an event by the private contractor for the city. This does not include residential streets. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 14 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Annual 20 Cubic Yard Exemption
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for residential customers to claim their annual oversized brush/bulk collection not to exceed 20 cubic yards. The service request must be submitted the week prior to the scheduled brush/bulk collection week (customers can not use this Service Request type to replace a Cost-Plus request). An excessive fee of $60 per five cubic yards will be directly billed to the customer's Dallas Water Utilities account if the debris set out is more than the monthly 10 cubic yards without the annual oversized exemption service request, or if the annual oversized exemption is more than 20 cubic yards. A resident is also subject to a Citation issued by Code Compliance for violating the limit size (City Code Sec. 18-4 (h)(3)). For more information on the new brush/bulk regulations, please Click Here.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Commercial Services
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use to request new commercial roll cart and/or dumpster service, make changes to the existing commercial service, or cancel service. Businesses, City Facilities, and Multi-Family Properties can request commercial roll cart services. ONLY CITY FACILITIES can request Dumpster Service. If you live in a Multi-Family Property, i.e., apartment/condo/townhome, your service will be approved on a case-by-case basis. All service addresses considered business/commercial must have an active Dallas Water Utilities account with active water to proceed with this request. A signed Commercial Service Agreement must also be obtained to provide/continue service. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Dead Animal Pick Up
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request the removal of dead animals. Place the deceased animal in a plastic bag (if possible) and relocate it to the front curb of your property for removal. A $125 service fee will be applied to the Dallas Water Utility account number associated with the service address if the animal weighs more than 100 pounds. Requests received Monday-Friday after 5PM, Saturday after 2:30PM, or Sunday after 1:30PM are resolved the next business day. The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation District Billing Dispute
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request only for sanitation billing disputes related to cost-plus or brush/bulk debris removal, business/commercial or pack-out garbage/recycle service, questions on frequency of service received, residential roll-cart(s) quantity, and property inspections. A person claiming entitlement to a refund/credit must provide notification to the Sanitation Department within 180 days (6 months) from the date the disputed payment was received by the City or day of collection service. The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Helping Hands
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to Initiate/Cancel/Renew garbage and recycle collection assistance. A Helping Hands Program Application and Declaration of Special Need form must be completed, signed, and returned to Sanitation Headquarters for review and approval. Please note, all customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related sanitation fees. NOTE: Sanitation residential customers who are physically disabled and living without an able-bodied person that can relocate their roll cart(s) to the point of collection may be eligible for the Helping Hands Program at no additional cost. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Litter Cans
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for issues concerning the service of the litter can. These are the METAL containers found ON the median at a stop light or ON the sidewalk in front of a business. If the litter can is at a DART Station OR DART Bus Stop, contact DART at 214-749-3333. If your issue is with a grey garbage roll cart or a blue recycle roll cart, please use the Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery SR type. The estimated response time (ERT) for a request of this nature is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Missed Brush/Bulk
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a missed residential brush/bulk collection. Sanitation Services has until 6:00 P.M. on the Friday of the scheduled collection week to pick up brush/bulk debris from the service location. If you have received an Orange Tag on your brush/bulk debris, a collection violation was identified and needs to be corrected in order for your location to be serviced. Collection will be attempted on your next scheduled day of service or week. Visit DallasCityHall.com/Sanitation to Contact Us online or by phone. Business/Commercial accounts are not currently serviced for brush/bulk collections. The estimated initial response time for a service request of this nature is 2 business days. Missed bulk/brush service is resolved within 7 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Missed Garbage
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report missed garbage collection. Sanitation Services has until 8:00 P.M. on the scheduled collection day to pick up garbage from the service location. If you have received an Orange Tag on your garbage roll cart(s), a collection violation was identified and needs to be corrected in order for your location to be serviced. Collection will be attempted on your next scheduled day of service or week. Visit DallasCityHall.com/Sanitation to Contact Us online or by phone. The estimated initial response time for a service request of this nature is 2 business days. Missed garbage services are resolved within 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Missed Recycle
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report missed recycle collection. Sanitation Services has until 8:00 P.M. on the scheduled collection day to pick up recycle from the service location. If you have received an Orange Tag on your recycle roll cart(s), a collection violation was identified and needs to be corrected in order for your location to be serviced. Collection will be attempted on your next scheduled day of service or week. Visit DallasCityHall.com/Sanitation to Contact Us online or by phone. The estimated initial response time for a service request of this nature is 2 business days. Missed recycle services are resolved within 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Pack-Out
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request pack-out service from Sanitation. For an additional fee, customers can add Pack-Out service which enables sanitation crews to go onto their private property (at an approved location) to provide collection service for our City issued garbage/recycle roll cart(s). If you wish to opt in for this service, an application is required. Please note, all customers will continue to be charged the residential collection service rate and any other related sanitation fees. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Property Damage
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report all property damages ONLY caused by sanitation trucks. For damaged roll carts, use the Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery service request. If a customer would like to file a complaint against a sanitation driver/employee, use the Complaint/Compliment – 311 service request type. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery
categoryNames: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request repairs/replacements or delivery of roll carts. For RESIDENTIAL CUSTOMERS ONLY, use to request new roll cart service (no roll carts are on property) or the additional/removal of a roll cart(s). All customers (Commercial/Business, Residential, or Multi-Family) can also use this request for the maintenance of existing roll cart(s). The fee for each additional residential garbage roll cart is $15.51. Effective October 1, 2023, the owner or occupant of a dwelling unit with one roll cart for recyclable materials may request one additional roll cart for recyclable materials from the director of sanitation for no additional fee. Dwelling units with two or more roll carts for recyclable materials may request additional roll carts for recyclable materials for a one-time processing and handling fee for $50.00 per roll cart, which will be applied to the dwelling unit’s water account. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: School Crossing Guard
portalServiceTypes.description: Use to request a school crossing guard or report a crossing guard not at their post. Also use to report complaints, compliments and concerns related to school crossing guards, i.e., employee conduct, safety issues, information about the program, etc. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: School Zone Flasher Maintenance
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report or request maintenance or repairs to school zone flashers. ** To request a new school zone flasher use 'Traffic Sign - New - TPW ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Scooter/Bike Shared Dockless Vehicle
categoryNames: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report concerns or issues with shared dockless scooters or bikes (i.e., scooters and bikes that are rented with a smartphone app) that are incorrectly parked, are damaged/inoperable, or are being operated improperly. Contact the relevant company for any other violations. The estimated response time for this service request is 4 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sewage Discharge Urgent
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report sewage discharging into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sewer Problems
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report sewer problems. In case of a sewer emergency please call 311. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Shopping Cart Pickup
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report five or more shopping carts that are blocking a street, alley or sidewalk. The city will NOT remove carts from private property. If a cart is located on private property, the citizen must move the cart to the parkway (grassy area between the street and sidewalk). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Shopping Carts Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report an abandoned shopping cart that is blocking a street, alley or sidewalk. This request for service will be dispatched to an emergency response truck to remove the shopping cart. **If cart is not abandoned notify Police/9-1-1 ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Short Term/Vacation Rental Survey
portalServiceTypes.description: The City of Dallas uses this service request to track and survey customers about possible issues regarding short term rental/vacation properties. Information provided in this service request will be used for tracking purposes only. If assistance from a service department is needed, please submit the appropriate service request in addition to this survey. Please note, this survey is regarding possible violations occurring when a property is rented out to a tenant temporarily (Ex AirBNB, Homestay, Vacasa, etc.)

portalServiceTypes.title: Sidewalk Replacement Program
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to obtain a petition to participate in a cost share residential sidewalk replacement program that assists in replacing existing deteriorated residential sidewalks. ** Sidewalks are the responsibility of the home owner. ** This is a cost share program between the City and the citizen (home owner). Not for businesses. ** For updates or additional information Click Here  The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Sidewalk Utility Obstruction
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report sidewalks obstructed by the positioning of a utility pole, fire hydrant, in ground/above ground utility box or permanent signage and does not meet ADA specifications. ** Call 3-1-1 for hazardous sidewalks. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Single Family Rental Needs Registration
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report rental property NOT registered with the City of Dallas or for any issues and concerns related to the registration of rental properties, or Code Concerns at single family rental properties (single family, duplexes and rented condominium units). The estimated response time for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Smoke Detector Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to inquire about a smoke detector for owner occupied single-family and duplex residences. This does not apply to rental properties such as apartments or rent houses. The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Smoking Violation
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report smoking occurring at FOOD and NON-FOOD establishments, i.e., at Bingo and Billiard Halls, Bars, Convenience Stores in any City of Dallas owned or operated facility or office building. The estimated response time for this service request is 7 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Snow/Ice Sanding - Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report hazardous/emergency locations needing sanding during snow and/or icing conditions. **The City does not sand residential streets, only major thoroughfares. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Social Services Request
portalServiceTypes.description: *** Use this service request to request social service assistance related to the structure fire at the 400 block of E 9th Street that occurred on May 28, 2026.*** You may also use this service type to request social service assistance – connection to the care or resources (includes but not limited to the connection to food banks, healthcare facilities, behavioral health clinics, service-based programming, and workforce assistance). The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 1 business day. *** For rental assistance use - Housing & Neighborhood Revitalization Requests. Homeless concerns see - Homeless Encampments.

portalServiceTypes.title: Special Events Non-Permitted Activity Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report someone selling merchandise, food/drink/alcohol, setting up tents, stages, bleachers, or projection technology, with street closures or activations/booths on sidewalks or on public streets that do not have a special event permit from the City's Office of Special Events (CES-OSE). ** Not for permits issued for garage sales, neighborhood block parties, animals, or Dallas Convention Center events. ** The estimated response time for this service request is 24 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Special Events Permit Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request a permit for any outdoor special event, commercial filming activity in the City of Dallas, Dallas Street seats, and commercial promoter registration. This includes parades, foot races, street festivals and State Fair of Texas Parking licenses. ** Not for permits issued for garage sales, neighborhood block parties, animals, Dallas Convention Center events or Fair Park events. ** The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days. To complete an application Click Here

portalServiceTypes.title: Speed Limit Change Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to request changes in speed limits for streets within the Dallas city limits. For freeways please contact TXDOT. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 69 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Steel Plates in Street (Covering Utility Street Cuts/Excavation)
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report loose or shifted steel plates over street excavation. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Storm Drainage/Flooding Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report flooding from rising water in creeks or an overflow of water in the street due to inadequately sized drainage system. Use this for non-emergency services only. The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Storm Sewer Line Locate
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request a storm line-locate. A storm line-locate is most often needed when construction requires a vertical bore or a horizontal bore. Any activity that requires digging near a street or easement should have a line-locate prior to digging. Line-locates are occasionally requested so that construction can plan where to connect a storm drain.The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Storm Water Construction Site Urgent
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report an illicit discharge, sediment tracking, solid waste pollution or any other environmental concern pertaining to a Construction site going into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Storm Water Industrial Site Urgent
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report an illicit discharge, solid waste pollution or any other environmental concern pertaining to an Industrial facility going into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 calendar days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Street Lamp/Light - New/Relocation
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request additional street lighting or a street light where none has existed. Also, to relocate an existing street light. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Street Lamp/Light Maintenance
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report maintenance needed for a street light or highway lighting (including high mast and underpass lighting). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days. Due to requiring lane closures, you may experience delays on maintenance of highway lighting. **Please report street lights that are mounted on wooden poles directly to Oncor 1-888-313-4747 or Click Here **

portalServiceTypes.title: Street Repair
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report minor street repairs such as pot holes, standing water, damaged surface, broken curbs and gutters. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Street Resurface Program
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to inquire about a street resurfacing (asphalt) project that is currently under construction and being performed by the city. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report hazardous spills or debris blocking the public right-of-way to include driving or travel lanes of traffic. ** Freeways are the responsibility of Texas Dept. of Transportation (TXDOT). ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 12 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Street Sweeping - Thoroughfares
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report sweeping needed on major thoroughfares ONLY, no residential streets, private property or parking lots. If a Hazard (such as, glass or other harmful debris) exists on a residential street call 3-1-1 and refer to Street Spillage/Debris in Right-of-Way – Hazardous, and city crews will respond. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days. NOTE: Sweeping is completed once a month along the scheduled route, weather permitting. The city has a systematic cleaning schedule that covers all major traffic thoroughfares within Dallas. Cleaning includes sweeping along the curb line at each location.

portalServiceTypes.title: Street, Road or Driveway Blockage
categoryNames: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Use this service request to report non-emergency concerns regarding vehicles that are blocking the street/roadway/driveway that may be abandoned/unoccupied or disabled in the roadway in need of traffic control until the vehicle is in a safe location or not blocking the roadway 24 hours a day. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 6 hours. ** Please call 911 for emergency conditions or freeway concerns **

portalServiceTypes.title: Survey Questions - Public Right of Way
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request survey information on a City of Dallas public right-of-way. **Be advised the City does not do surveys for personal or private property. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

knowledgeArticleMatches.title: Survey Questions Public Right of Way – SR Description

portalServiceTypes.title: Swimming Pool Discharge Urgent
categoryNames: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a swimming pool, hot tub or private pond discharging into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Towing Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns regarding towing companies, operators and services. Your name and phone number are required to continue with this request. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic - Speed Control
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to inquire about the installation of traffic speed control on a street. It should be used to address excessive speed, pedestrian and bicycle safety, cut-through traffic, crashes and quality of life issues. A study and petition will be required if requesting speed control measures. (Measures could include: road/speed humps, street markings, bicycle lanes and/or speed trailers) **This request requires a name, address, and phone number. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 30 business days. ***** For chronic or recurring speeding/traffic violations use Traffic Violations (Chronic) - DPD or Extra Patrol - DPD.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Construction Signs
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a problem with signage, signs, or cones of ongoing construction on City of Dallas streets. (Ex. - signs that may be missing, moved or knocked over or signs that were left at a construction site once work has been completed.) The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Markings - Maintenance
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for maintenance on all traffic markings for streets in Dallas city limits. This would include lane lines, center stripes, crosswalks, stop bars, lane delineations, etc. It does not include any curb markings. Maintenance on highways should go to the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 Business Days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Markings - New
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns related to new traffic markings. Including: lane line striping, edge lines, crosswalks, stop legends, etc. This can also be used to remove existing markings. A name, address, and daytime phone are required for this request. ** For highways or freeways please contact Texas Department of Transportation (TXDOT). ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Sign - New
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request the installation of a new traffic sign or to request the removal of a sign. **Signs for trails and trail crossings must be submitted to the Park & Recreation department using “Park Maintenance/Misc – PKR”. Signs include - school zone, dip, yield, stop, no parking, one way, speed limit, and street name blades. **A name, address and daytime phone are required. ** Signs for Buildings/Parking lots are the owner's responsibility. Highway signs contact TXDOT. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 35 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Sign - Visibility Obstruction
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report visibility obstructions for stop, yield or one-way signs only. Place all other signs on Traffic Sign - Maintenance (Other). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Sign Knockdown
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report knocked down or missing stop signs, yield signs or one-way signs only. Place all other signs on Traffic Sign - Maintenance (Other). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report non-hazardous problems with traffic signs in need of maintenance, i.e. faded, damaged, knocked down, etc. Signs include street name blades, school crossing, dip, no parking, speed limit, etc. Signs for businesses or parking lots are the owner's responsiility. ** Please call 3-1-1 if a STOP, ONE WAY or YIELD sign is down or to report a Radar Feedback Sign issue. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal - Flashing
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report signals that are flashing a single color. ** Use School Zone Flasher Maintenance for school zone flashers. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TRN
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a traffic signal, school zone flasher, or traffic signal control box that has been hit or knocked down completely to where the damage causes a signal malfunction. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal - Lights Out All Directions
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a traffic signal where signal lights are all out/completely dark in all directions. *** Do not use this for flashing signal lights, street lights, or single color bulb outage *** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal - New
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request the installation of a brand new traffic signal where one has never existed or to request a current traffic signal be removed. The evaluation to determine addition or removal of the traffic signal is a multi-step process and may take several weeks to complete. **A name, address and daytime phone number is required. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 35 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal Head Turned or Not Visible
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a traffic signal head that is turned and cannot be seen by motorists in that lane of travel, multiple bulbs are out, or shows conflicting colors, e.g. driver can see both a green light and a red light at the same time in their direction of travel. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal Maintenance - Report a Problem
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report other Non-Emergency signal concerns such as a partially blocked signal, a single signal bulb burned out, graffiti on a signal sign or control box and a broken pedestrian crossing button. *** For school zone flasher issues - use 'School Zone Flasher Maintenance - TPW' and Traffic Signal - Modification - TPW for signal timing issues. *** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal Stuck
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report when the traffic signal is stuck on one color or the indication is not changing. This service request requires the color and direction of travel. ** Do not use this for timing/sync issues. Use 'Traffic Signal - Modification - TPW'. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signal Timing and Modification
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report signal timing/sync issues or to modify an existing traffic signal for a pedestrian crossing light, signal warning flasher, left turn signal, thru/right turn signal and bicycle lane signal. ***Contact name, email address and/or daytime phone is required if any additional information is needed*** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Traffic Signals and Lighting - Line Locate
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request a traffic signaling (pedestrian and vehicle signals, flashers, message signs, signal communication) or street lighting line-locate at an intersection or within a street block. A line-locate is most often needed when construction requires a vertical bore/trench or a horizontal bore/trench. Any activity that requires digging near a street or easement shall have a line-locate prior to digging. Line-locates are occasionally requested so that construction can proceed without impacting existing infrastructure. *** Upload the 811 request email confirmation and photos of work site or marked up map where line-locates are requested *** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Transportation Complaint
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns regarding transportation services such as ambulances, limousines and taxi's, as well as, non-motorized transportation, i.e., carriages, petty cabs, trolley's, etc. Also use to request regulation of drivers, permits and companies. Contact information is required to submit this service request. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Tree down/Low Limbs - Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this request to report hazardous trees down in the street or alley, leaning trees that are about to fall into the street, alley, or onto the public right of way, and hazardous low limbs hanging over into the street or sidewalk. ** Trees/Limbs on private property are property owner's responsibility. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 12 hours.

portalServiceTypes.title: Unsheltered Feeding
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this Service Request to notify the City of Dallas of a hosted homeless meal event or to report a concern regarding a homeless meal event. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Utility Complaint/Information
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for utility complaints or utility information. If request is related to an Out of Order Street Light, please use SR type "Street Lighting - Maintenance." The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 10 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Utility Cut - Routine
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request type to report concerns about cuts made in the street, alley or sidewalk made by utility companies. A utility cut is when a contractor has cut an opening into the street and covers the hole up with a steel plate because work is not finished. ** Utility Cuts are generally - Square or Rectangle in shape, if other please complete a Street Repair - Routine SR. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Utility Street Cuts - Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report concerns about cuts made in street, alley or sidewalk that are hazardous. A utility cut is when a contractor has cut an opening into the street and covers the hole up with a steel plate because work is not finished. ** Utility Cuts are generally - SQUARE, if other please complete a Street Repair - Routine SR. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Valet Parking Complaint
categoryNames: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a complaint regarding valet services at a location or a valet company. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Visibility Obstruction
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report any visibility obstructions that are caused when a vehicle cannot see oncoming traffic due to overgrown vegetation, shrubs, grass or low hanging limbs within a street median. Use Code Concern for alleys or sidewalks. ** If a traffic sign or signal is obstructed please Call 3-1-1 for assistance. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Visibility Obstruction - Hazardous
portalServiceTypes.description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a hazardous visibility obstruction caused by overgrown vegetation blocking the view of traffic. ** Overgrown trees, bushes, and vegetation on private property is the property owner's responsibility. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Water Main Leak/Break
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report a water main leak or main break on a public right of way. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Water Payments & Billing Inquiry
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request if you have a question regarding your monthly water bill statement or payments made to your account. Do not user this service request to request restoration of service, service discontinuance, new service or theft of water. For those types of request, please call Water Customer Service at 214-651-1441. For questions about garbage pickup call 311. The estimated response time for this service request is 4 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Water Pollution Urgent
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to report dumping of any materials on City or vacant property that is exposed to rain or that can enter into a creek, river or lake. Use this service request if an emergency or urgent response is needed. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

portalServiceTypes.title: Water Questions
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to submit a general request or concern related to Water. Please call 214-651-1441 Monday-Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm for routine Water calls such as making a payment, service discontinuance, theft of water, or water quality concerns. For Water emergencies such as a main break, burst pipes, leaks doing property damage or sewer issues please call 3-1-1 or 214-670-3111. The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Water Utilities Payment Plan Request
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to have City staff call you to set up a Water Utility account payment plan. Please complete the requested fields to request a call back regarding a payment arrangement or other options to prevent disconnection. Due to the high volume of requests, it may take up to five business days before you are contacted. If you have received a disconnection notice please contact 214-651-1441 for assistance. Do not use this service request for general inquiries or Water emergencies.

knowledgeArticleMatches.title: Water Utilities Payment Plan Request – SR Description

portalServiceTypes.title: Water/Sanitary Sewer Construction Project
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request to request information and ask questions regarding water and wastewater construction projects. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

portalServiceTypes.title: Water/Wastewater Line Locate
portalServiceTypes.description: FOR PUBLIC SYSTEM LOCATION ONLY. Use this to request a routine water / wastewater line locate from Dallas Water Utilities. Be advised only ONE location per Service Request (SR) is allowed and all requests will be handled as "Mark and go" locates. If water lines are outside the city of Dallas, please call 8-1-1. This request will be scheduled and closed within 1 business day. Once your request is scheduled and closed, Dallas Water Utilities has 3 additional business days to complete your line locate request.

portalServiceTypes.title: Wheel Chair Ramp/Curb Street Cuts
portalServiceTypes.description: Use this service request for concerns regarding the installation of a Wheel Chair Ramp, Curb Cut, or Barrier Free Ramp at a city street intersection.
